svg.title: Manage commands and keyboard shortcuts
svg.desc: The production CommandBuilderModal reads two example saved commands through the actual CustomCommandManager. Obsidian's fixture reports no assigned hotkeys, so the real shortcut chips read Blank; the built-in command list retains its production toggles and scrolling layout.
